page.overview:
Who is Christine?

Christine is a goat who lives in the Animal Village. She loves eating paper and corresponds with Mr. Write from Mabe Village. When Link talks to her for the first time, Christine says to him that the proper etiquette is to give flowers when first meeting a lady. During the game's , in exchange for a Hibiscus flower, Christine gives Link a Letter that must be delivered to Mr. Write. When the Letter is delivered, it is revealed that it is apparently a love letter, and that Christine has enclosed a photograph. Although Mr. Write believes the photo to be of Christine herself, it is actually an image of Princess Peach from the Super Mario franchise.

Christine owns a green Bird while Mr. Write owns an orange bird.
